title: Kerala High Court Strikes Down Kerala Minerals Vesting Law, Says Deprivation Of Private Property Without Compensation Violates Article 300A
description: The Kerala High Court has declared the Kerala Minerals (Vesting of Rights) Act 2021 as unconstitutional, holding that the State cannot vest ownership of privately owned mineral rights in itself without providing compensation or complying with the constitutional safeguards under Article 300A.
